FU.XPTriggersNote: Award XP after the session if any of these are true. (Reference only.)
FU.XPTrigger.Enemy: The characters overcame a significant enemy or threat
FU.XPTrigger.Prize: The characters won a significant prize or advantage
FU.XPTrigger.Detail: The characters learnt an important detail about the world
FU.XPTrigger.Mission: The characters completed their mission or achieved a goal
FU.AdvanceEdge: Write a new Edge for any Trademark
FU.MaxStat: This stat is already at maximum.
FU.EdgeAdvanceIntro: Add a new Edge to one of your Trademarks. This will cost 10 XP.
FU.BossNote: Boss: Add Hits equal to the number of PCs (GM sets manually).

FU.ActionPH: An action this threat takes or might take
FU.ThreatTagsPH: Tags describing capabilities, weaknesses and behaviours (comma- or line-separated).
FU.ProblemsPH: GM reference — what happens if the players are slow or struggling...
FU.AR.Title: ACTION ROLLER
FU.AR.TrademarksHint: Pick one or two. A second Trademark costs 1 Drama Point.
FU.AR.FlawsHint: If a flaw applies to this situation, check it.
FU.AR.GearHint: If an asset applies, check it.
FU.AR.InjuriesHint: If an injury applies then check it.
FU.AR.ConditionsHint: If a Condition applies then check it.
FU.AR.GMHint: Danger or circumstance modifiers from the GM.
FU.AR.DramaSpentLine: Spent {n} Drama Point for second Trademark
FU.AR.NoDramaForSecond: Not enough Drama Points to select a second Trademark.
FU.AR.NoGMOnline: No GM online — rolling without confirmation
FU.AR.GMReviewNoActor: Roll request received for an actor that is not available on this client.
FU.Settings.PressureEnabled.Name: Enable Pressure Tracker
FU.Settings.PressureEnabled.Hint: Show a scene-level Pressure tracker (0–6) for the GM.
FU.Settings.PressureAuto.Name: Auto-increment Pressure
FU.Settings.PressureAuto.Hint: After every roll, add 1 to Pressure for each uncancelled Danger Die showing 6.
FU.Settings.DefaultThreatHits.Name: Default Threat Hits
FU.Settings.DefaultThreatHits.Hint: Starting Hits value for newly created Threat actors.

FU.Settings.OracleMode.Hint: Choose between the Action Tales four-band Oracle (Complete/Partial/Failure/Botch) or FU 2e's original six-outcome Oracle (Yes and/Yes/Yes but/No but/No/No and).
FU.AR.ALittleLuckHint: Spend 1 Drama Point to change a die result by ±1 pip.

FU.Settings.MaxAdvantages.Name: Maximum Advantages
FU.Settings.MaxAdvantages.Hint: Maximum Advantages per character before Custom indicator triggers. Default: 3.
FU.Settings.MaxTies.Name: Maximum Ties
